features.name: Project setup & verification
features.description: App installs and verifies from a clean checkout: npm install, tsc --noEmit, expo lint, expo export --platform ios all succeed.
features.evidence: tsc --noEmit clean; expo lint clean; expo export --platform ios exit 0 (1107 modules). See README + init.sh.

features.name: Worksite data + screens (consult)
features.description: Home overview, rover roster list, and rover detail. Reads simulated worksite data (rovers + tasks) from src/services/worksite.ts.
features.evidence: src/app/index.tsx, rovers/index.tsx, rovers/[id].tsx; data in src/services/worksite.ts. Bundled in expo export.

features.name: Report occurrence flow (cadastro -> status)
features.description: Validated incident form (rover, type, severity, description) -> persists to AsyncStorage -> confirmation/status screen showing the self-heal system response.
features.evidence: src/app/report.tsx, confirmation.tsx; persistence in src/services/reports.ts. Validation + error states implemented.

features.name: Notifications native resource
features.description: Coordinator self-heal alerts via expo-notifications (local). Filing a report pushes the system response (deep-links to confirmation); the home 'Monitor do enxame' simulates a swarm failure/re-auction event. Handles permission request + denied state. Replaces the earlier forced GPS resource with one that fits the ops-companion theme.
features.evidence: src/services/notifications.ts; wired in report.tsx (self-heal push), index.tsx (monitor card + simulate), _layout.tsx (tap deep-link incl. cold start). expo-notifications plugin in app.json. tsc + lint clean; expo export --platform ios exit 0.

features.name: History (AsyncStorage)
features.description: List all stored occurrences (newest first), open details, clear history. Empty/error/loading states.

features.name: Delivery evidence (video + screenshots + repo link)
features.description: Record a short video of the full flow (home -> rovers -> detail -> report with GPS -> confirmation -> history), capture screenshots, and fill the placeholders in README.md (video + git repo link). Required by the rubric; missing evidence loses points.
